PM is near 85 deg because the mirror pole is ~6x GBW. Swing is about 0.45-1.65 V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion for efficiency)
    "L1":     (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # input pair L (gain vs. cap)
    "itail":  (7.0e-6, 5.5e-6, 8.0e-6),
    "gmid_l": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L_l":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS load L (gain, flicker)
    "gmid_t": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # tail / reference mirror gm/Id
    "L_t":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # tail L (CMRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    # Tail mirror: reference diode carries iref, tail mirrors it down to itail
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], it, vds=0.35)

    # Input pair: source sits about one Vgs below VCM = 0.9 V
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.55, vsb=0.35)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_l"], p["L_l"], i1, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # Bias: ibias is sunk by a diode-connected nfet
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # Diff pair: vinp drives the output-side device, so the output is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)      # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)   # output side
    # Mirror load: diode on the x side, output on the M2 side
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    # The mirror pole-zero doublet costs roughly half the phase of a lone pole
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fp2)) * 0.5
    sr = it / cout
    # Settling: slew part for an assumed ~0.5 V step, plus linear settling ln(100)*tau
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = max(0.0, 0.5 / sr - tau) + 4.6 * tau
    # Thermal noise only (flicker is reduced by the large-area long-L devices)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sv = 16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv) * 3.0     # factor 3 margin for flicker at 1 kHz
    # CMRR ~ 2*gm1*Rtail * gm3/gds_mirror-ish (first order)
    cmrr = db(max(2 * gm1 / mt.gds * (m3.gm / (m3.gds + 1e-12)) / 50.0, 1.0))
    psrr = db(a0)                    # 5T OTA: PSRR(VDD) ~ A0 to first order
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (iref + it)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "noise_1k": noise,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "slew": sr, "settle": settle,
        "power": power, "swing": swing,
    }
```
